features: tabular-nums on values + numeric table cells

notes: Default new-york-v4 theme; the CSS ships dozens of swappable theme presets (stone/blue/lime/…) — captured the shipped neutral default and its .dark counterpart. 'accent' role mapped to the black primary action color, not shadcn's internal --accent (which is the #f5f5f5 hover fill, recorded as muted-fill). scroll_effects is empty: the page has no scroll-driven motion — the only layout animation is the user-toggled rail width collapse (transition-[width] ease-linear 200ms), captured under techniques. chart-ramp is the token blue ramp, but the dashboard's area chart renders as a neutral black→transparent gradient. Shadows normalized away on cards: measured card shadow is all-zero; elevation is border-only.
